notes: The evaluator uses the standard uniform cubic B-spline four-control-point basis independently in U and V.
Source Step is treated as the number of straight subdivisions per patch span; 5x4 controls therefore produce 2x1 cubic spans and a 7x4 sample lattice at Step 3.
Closed type-3 directions remain unsupported because no type-3 closed-direction record exists in the supplied corpus.

evidence_boundary.corpus: All three class-1 surface-type-code-3 records are 5x4 open/open records with tension 0.5 and Step 3. The 183-record class-1 census independently validates the common binary envelope.
evidence_boundary.historical_softimage_behavior: Softimage documentation describes B-splines as best-fit curves that do not pass through edit points and describes Step as the subdivisions used to tessellate each UV patch section.
evidence_boundary.enum_correspondence: Autodesk MotionBuilder FBSurfaceType orders Cardinal as 2 and Bspline as 3. This is supporting correspondence, not asserted as direct proof that every legacy Softimage-3D binary enum shares the same implementation.
evidence_boundary.production_policy: Type 3 is now evaluated as open uniform cubic B-spline. Type 2 remains the existing control-cage approximation until Cardinal interpolation and closed-boundary semantics are independently validated.
